-- functions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_qdrant_point_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO qdrant_delete_queue (point_id)
    VALUES (OLD.id)
    ON CONFLICT (point_id) DO NOTHING;
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.eval_reject_split_manifest_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'eval golden-set split manifests are immutable';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.eval_reject_split_reassignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.eval_split IS NOT NULL AND NEW.eval_split IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.eval_split THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'eval question split assignments are immutable';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_slack_public_scopes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP <> 'UPDATE' THEN
        PERFORM pg_notify('diderot_slack_public_scopes', '');
    ELSIF ROW(OLD.channel_id, OLD.name, OLD.is_private)
          IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.channel_id, NEW.name, NEW.is_private) THEN
        PERFORM pg_notify('diderot_slack_public_scopes', '');
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_legacy_ask_prompt_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy Ask prompt history is immutable';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_legacy_session_archive_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy session supersession history is immutable';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_prompt_release_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'prompt release history is immutable';
END;
$function$

-- triggers
CREATE TRIGGER eval_golden_set_splits_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.eval_golden_set_splits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION eval_reject_split_manifest_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER eval_questions_split_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF eval_split ON public.eval_questions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION eval_reject_split_reassignment() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER event_chunks_enqueue_qdrant_delete AFTER DELETE ON public.event_chunks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enqueue_qdrant_point_delete() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER legacy_ask_prompts_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.legacy_ask_prompts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_legacy_ask_prompt_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER legacy_ask_session_prompts_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.legacy_ask_session_prompts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_legacy_ask_prompt_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER legacy_session_event_chunk_archive_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.legacy_session_event_chunk_archive FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_legacy_session_archive_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER legacy_session_event_supersessions_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.legacy_session_event_supersessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_legacy_session_archive_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER prompt_release_activations_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.prompt_release_activations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_prompt_release_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER prompt_release_entries_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.prompt_release_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_prompt_release_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER prompt_releases_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.prompt_releases FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_prompt_release_mutation() enabled=O
CREATE TRIGGER slack_public_scopes_changed AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.slack_channel_info FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_slack_public_scopes() enabled=O
-- views
-- policies
-- comments
column activity_ts of table slack_thread_sync: Generated thread activity recency (Slack ts, fixed-width text so lexicographic==numeric). COALESCE(latest_reply, thread_ts) is the later of the root and Slack's reported latest reply. Pure source data, never a processing timestamp.
column ask_enabled of table slack_channel_config: When false (default), maybeRouteAsk silently drops @-mentions in this channel. Operator opts a channel in via `diderot slack channels config allow-ask <id>`.
column backfill_requested_at of table linear_sync: Non-null while the leader worker is consuming durable Linear issue pages for an operator replay.
column backfill_requested_at of table notion_sync: Non-null while the leader worker is consuming durable Notion search pages for an operator replay.
column cache_read_tokens of table ask_messages: Bedrock Converse Usage.CacheReadInputTokens (prompt-cache hits) for the turn.
column cache_write_tokens of table ask_messages: Reserved for a future provider-neutral source. Ask Responses rows leave this NULL; Agent Gateway is authoritative.
column channel_id of table slack_ingest_blacklist: Stable Slack channel identity used for all blacklist matching.
column channel_name of table slack_ingest_blacklist: Informational channel name captured when the entry was added; renames do not change identity.
column cursor of table slack_channel_sync: Saved pagination cursor mid-sweep. NULL when idle. Persisted every page so restarts resume cleanly.
column done_at of table slack_thread_sync: NULL while not-yet-walked or actively re-opened. Set to now() at successful walk completion. The discovery upsert resets this to NULL on re-discovery (parent showed up with new replies).
column heartbeat_at of table admin_jobs: Last proof that the process executing this job was alive; a new start may fail an expired active row before claiming the kind.
column in_progress_at of table slack_channel_sync: Wall clock at start (or last heartbeat) of the in-flight sweep. NULL when idle. Heartbeats every page; stale-recovery threshold is sized to "longest plausible single page," not "longest plausible total sweep."
column index_failure_count of table session_ingest_candidates: Consecutive failed index attempts for index_failure_revision.
column index_failure_revision of table session_ingest_candidates: Revision the index_* failure state describes; ignored once the observed head moves past it.
column index_last_error of table session_ingest_candidates: Bounded diagnostic from the latest failed index attempt.
column index_quarantined_at of table session_ingest_candidates: Set only for a permanent failure of an immutable revision (e.g. over the byte cap); transient failures never quarantine. Cleared manually or by a new revision.
column index_retry_at of table session_ingest_candidates: Earliest time a transiently failed revision is selectable again (capped exponential backoff).
column ingest_enabled of table slack_channel_sync: Per-row effective gate. Worker pick query filters this out. Distinct from slack_ingest_blacklist (cross-cutting policy table); reconcile reconciles the two.
column initial_model_id of table ask_sessions: Configured inference model for the first recorded turn; NULL for historical sessions.
column initial_scopes of table ask_sessions: Allowed corpus scopes of the first recorded turn, written with surface. NULL for sessions that predate it. A Slack turn may continue a pagerduty session only when its own scopes contain all of these.
column input_tokens of table ask_messages: Bedrock Converse Usage.InputTokens for the turn. NULL on user-role rows or pre-migration assistant rows.
column integration_id of table notion_sync: Notion /users/me bot ID for the credential that established last_discovery_at.
column judged_content_hash of table eval_judgments: Body-only events.content_hash captured when the judgment was written.
column judged_eval_content_hash of table eval_judgments: Title+body events.eval_content_hash captured when known; NULL for historical rows whose title identity cannot be reconstructed.
column last_deep_sweep_at of table slack_channel_sync: Wall clock at successful completion of the most recent deep sweep (oldest floor at now-7d instead of the normal overlap). NULL = never deep-swept. When NULL or older than the deep-sweep cadence (24h), the next claim runs that channel as a deep sweep so old thread roots with new replies re-surface for the gated thread-root harvest.
column last_discovery_at of table notion_sync: Best-effort data-source Search watermark; never an ingestion completeness boundary.
column last_synced_at of table slack_channel_sync: Wall clock at successful completion of the most recent sweep, NULL = never swept. Live socket-mode events priority-bump this via LEAST(last_synced_at, now() - overlap).
column latest_reply of table slack_thread_sync: Pending value: parent latest_reply (Slack ts) observed by the sweep that enqueued/re-opened this row. text for lossless lexicographic comparison (Slack ts is fixed-width 10.6 until year 2286). Set on insert + re-open; left alone while a walk is in flight.
column message of table ask_messages: Validated Eino AgenticMessage JSON; no legacy Bedrock content envelope.
column message_schema_version of table ask_messages: Version of the bounded Eino AgenticMessage JSON persisted in message.
column oldest_ts of table slack_channel_sync: Unix-seconds float of the originating oldest_ts bound for the in-flight sweep, set alongside cursor every page. NULL when no sweep is mid-flight or the sweep was started without an oldest bound (full re-fetch). Preserves Slack history semantics across crash + resume.
column output_tokens of table ask_messages: Bedrock Converse Usage.OutputTokens for the turn. NULL on user-role rows or pre-migration assistant rows.
column owner_canonical of table session_ingest_candidates: Canonical owner identity used only for verified self-service owner joins.
column privacy_owner_only of table session_ingest_candidates: Explicit owner self-service override for this session; NULL uses deployment policy.
column prompt_release_id of table ask_sessions: Atomic prompt release pinned by the first model turn and reused by every continuation and delegated child.
column stale_after_seconds of table admin_jobs: Executor-owned lease duration used to classify and recover an active row whose heartbeat stops.
column surface of table ask_sessions: Ingress surface of the first recorded turn: http, slack, scheduled, or unknown for unmatched historical rows. NULL only before a new session records its first turn.
column title of table ask_sessions: Display title for this Diderot Ask only. NULL displays its UUID.
column title of table session_ingest_summaries: Short model-generated display title for the summary bound by title_input_digest.
column title_attempted_at of table ask_sessions: Claimed once after a successful answer; failures do not retry.
column title_input_digest of table session_ingest_summaries: Summary input_digest for which title was generated; mismatches are never displayed.
column title_model of table ask_sessions: Generator model id, or deterministic:fallback when retries were exhausted.
column visibility_scope of table session_ingest_candidates: Durable corpus audience: internal, or owner:<canonical owner> for owner-only agent sessions.
column walked_latest_reply of table slack_thread_sync: Confirmed value: promoted from latest_reply at markDone. The enqueue gate re-opens a completed row only when the freshly-observed parent latest_reply > walked_latest_reply. Conservative — promoted from the enqueue-time pending value, so a mid-walk reply triggers one redundant (NoChange) re-walk rather than being lost.
column worker_token of table slack_channel_sync: Random uuid assigned at claim time. Every state-mutating UPDATE in the worker carries a worker_token = $token guard.
column worker_token of table slack_thread_sync: Random uuid assigned at claim time. The discovery upsert NULLs this on re-open to invalidate any in-flight worker — without that, a worker mid-walk would still satisfy markDone's worker_token guard and write done_at=now(), erasing the re-walk request and losing the new replies forever.
table admin_jobs: Durable, attributable progress and outcome ledger for long-running administrator work.
table ask_inference_calls: Per-request model latency, usage, and served-tier telemetry for root and observability-child calls.
table ask_runs: One durable execution trace per Ask user turn.
table ask_tool_calls: Per-call tool latency and outcome telemetry for root and observability-child calls.
table legacy_ask_prompts: Recovered immutable Ask-only prompt versions used before atomic Git-authored catalog releases.
table legacy_ask_session_prompts: Recovered per-session Ask prompt provenance from the retired ask_sessions.initial_prompt_id column.
table linear_sync: Singleton state row for the linear ingest worker. Watermarks, visibility sweep timestamps, and backfill lease.
table notion_discovered_resources: Best-effort Notion Search discoveries for coverage auditing only; rows are never ingested without a managed-root path.
table notion_roots: Authoritative Notion corpus roots. Resource type is explicit when known; migrated bare UUIDs remain auto-probed.
table notion_sync: Singleton state row for the notion ingest worker. last_search_at and last_reconcile_at advance per loop tick; backfill_started_at is a 10-minute lease taken by the CLI to pause loops during a backfill run.
table slack_channel_sync: Continuous-worker state for slack ingest. One row per known channel. last_synced_at NULL = never swept (highest priority). cursor + in_progress_at + worker_token form the in-flight sweep state; worker uses worker_token guard on every state-mutating UPDATE to detect stolen claims. ingest_enabled is the per-row effective gate; slack_ingest_blacklist is the cross-cutting policy table.
table slack_ingest_blacklist: Explicit do-not-ingest override list. Bot membership normally drives ingest; this is the small exceptions list.
table slack_thread_sync: Pass-2 (conversations.replies) queue. Pass-1 history sweep upserts thread roots here on discovery; a sibling worker drains using the same global limiter. Re-discovery upserts re-open completed rows (new replies since last walk) and invalidate any in-flight worker_token to prevent the dead walker from erasing the re-walk request.
